message.reasoning_content: need to determine crimes. Facts:卫某某 bought prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) from 李某某, intending to resell for profit. He also defrauded victim 俞某某 by promising high profit from selling artifacts, got 5 million RMB, used for personal purposes, only returned 1 million and gave low-value artifacts. The artifacts are cultural relics (三级文物). Crimes: illegal possession/trafficking of cultural relics? He purchased prohibited cultural relics, which is illegal dealing in cultural relics (illegal acquisition, illegal sale). Also fraud (诈骗罪). Possibly also illegal possession of cultural relics (非法持有文物) and illegal trafficking (非法买卖文物). In examples, they used "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" for guns. For cultural relics, typical crime is "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal trade of cultural relics). Also "诈骗罪". So answer likely: [罪名]非法买卖文物;诈骗<eoa>. Check similar examples: earlier they had "非法获取国家秘密". For cultural relics, they might phrase as "非法买卖文物" or "非法买卖文物罪". Use "非法买卖文物". Provide both separated by semicolon.
